description: Two-person team at the Kuching hub tackling Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map. Ashley: CS student (web dev, UI, video editing). Johnson: Mechanical Engineering (EVA limits, walking-cost models). We’re building Marswalk Planner: plan a route across Jezero Crater using layered NASA data (terrain, slope, radiation), then walk it in first-person 3D with a sci-fi HUD. Looking for: Three.js/3D, geospatial data (Python, GDAL, DEM), planetary science, UI design. Beginners welcome!
